top_signals.title: Gold Trades Near $4,300 as Higher Oil Stokes Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Gold held a decline as increasing disruptions to oil flows from the Middle East reinforced expectations the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates as soon as this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Junk Debt From Asia Is Beating Bonds Almost Everywhere in 2026
top_signals.summary: Asian high-yield debt has emerged as a surprising global winner in bond markets as ever-cheaper money in China burnishes issuer finances.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
